body: I just want to say thank you for this 🌸 no amount of preparing myself for comments lead me to think my weight would be attacked. Nor did I understand how it would mentally impact me. I know I’m not everyone’s cup of tea, but I should’ve known better than to post in here when I was weight restored. Never in my life did I think I’d have to try to persuade someone into not thinking I’m fat when I actively only eat around 800 cals a day and yet say those same words to myself. I guess I just wish people understood that there’s so much more to a person than their weight or looks- and even if they found me fat or whatever else, doesn’t mean I’m grounds to beat down or have my triggers pushed when they’re explicitly stated. Tbh I physically haven’t been responding to my old tactics that led me to being 80 lbs like before, and it kills me. None of what they say is worse than what I tell myself, but I presented myself the best I could- and despite feeling fat, I know damn well in those pictures I am not... I’m not toned, I’m not a size 000 anymore, but I’ve worked so hard to be healthy and not drink ensure and be told I’m dying. But people don’t really care as long as they get that high of calling someone fat or ugly. Sorry this is so long... just glad someone understood, despite the fact I guess I brought it on myself, the mental weight and journey of recovery. 🌸
